name: Lian Lian Qing Ting
source:
To rejuvenate your family, you enter the palace harem bravely, from an anonymous maid to the powerful empress. You can decide what happens next, such as acquainting handsome confidants, cultivating children, and getting promoted by palace competing.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.taggame.jxen]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
为了振兴家族，你勇敢地进入后宫，从一个无名的宫女到有权有势的皇后。你可以决定接下来发生的事情，比如结识帅哥知己、培养孩子、通过宫斗晋级。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.taggame.jxen]Google Play[/url]]
